input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: perf: overlap the Pages build's tool share-card draw with the chrome pass

errors.what: First full-suite timing used /usr/bin/time, which this container lacks (rc 127); re-ran with date arithmetic.

doc_friction.issue: 'Where to look' step 3 names the Pages tests, but per-file they now sum to 99 s outside the build-heavy files; the build itself (cold card drawing, 60% main-thread idle) is where the time is. Pointing at a build --cpu-prof idle-window reading first would have saved a per-file sweep.

deviations.why: The stop hook asked to commit untracked files while a temporary copy of the old build.mjs was in use by a running A/B comparison.
deviations.did: Listed the file in the local .git/info/exclude instead of committing it; the A/B script deleted it on completion.

notes: Metric: wall time of a cold-card-cache full Pages build (env -u PAGES_CARD_CACHE node platform/pages/build.mjs --out=<dir>), 4-core container, alternating old (build.mjs from HEAD) and new runs. Before 127.0 / 123.9 s (mean 125.5), after 118.1 / 119.6 s (mean 118.8): -6.6 s, 5%. Output: diff -rq of old and new artifacts, 34,550 files, only version.json built_at differs. How found: node --cpu-prof of a cold build, 133.5 s wall, main thread idle 79.7 s (60%); 5 s windows showed workers drawing ~1,400 tool cards (20-35 s) while main idle, then addSiteChrome (35-60 s) while workers stopped. Change: start renderCards(cardJobs) before addSiteChrome, await before finishPagesInOneWalk. Tried and reverted (no gain, identical outputs on 48 inputs): a 16k-slot hash table in quantize instead of the 64/32 MB colour-indexed tables (8.7-9.3 vs 8.0-8.2 ms/card), and a run-based index pass (7.7 vs 7.9-8.2 ms, noise). Verification: node --test "*.test.mjs" "cloudflare/*.test.mjs" in platform/pages: 1862/1862 pass, 134 s wall (warm card cache); an earlier full run before the change took 233 s with a cold cache for the test base URL, so that difference is the cache, not this change. Post checks (check_posts, check_post_frontmatter) clean. CI pool reading: ci_profile --runs 600: Test the site builder 67.4 of 628.7 job-min.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: profile a 130 s build, two exact quantize experiments, one overlap change with byte-identical A/B, write-ups

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
